component.name: AdsCutter
component.summary: Cut ads out of TV recordings without re-encoding
Taglia la pubblicità dalle registrazioni TV senza ricodificare

description.p: AdsCutter removes advertising breaks from DVB-T/T2 television recordings. It reads MPEG transport streams and Matroska files and writes Matroska, copying the streams, so exporting is fast and the picture and sound are not degraded.

ul.li: Frame-accurate navigation, with every kept part starting on a frame where decoding can begin
MPEG-2, H.264 and HEVC video, with clean joins for H.264 and HEVC
Choice of the video, audio and subtitle streams to export
Vulkan and VAAPI hardware decoding, and deinterlacing
Optional ad detection from fades, separators and user-drawn regions, which proposes a cut list to review

description.p: Packaging and documentation: README, AppStream metadata, an AUR package and a man page fix.
